newPage.title: Create new micronarrative
newPage.description: Start a collaborative story where multiple authors will contribute text segments. Each participant adds their voice to the collective narrative.

howItWorksSteps.1: Define an attractive title and choose a creative prompt (optional)
howItWorksSteps.2: Set the maximum number of contributors (7-10 authors)
howItWorksSteps.3: Authors join automatically and contribute in turns
howItWorksSteps.4: Each segment must be between 50-100 words
howItWorksSteps.5: You have 2 minutes to write each segment
howItWorksSteps.6: The story is completed when everyone has contributed or voting ends it
